meta.title: A vendor that regretted every line is shown as regretted, not as "technically not acceptable"
gaps: The setup recipes provide only one line item and one QA vendor, so the three-line scenario with vendors A, B, and C cannot be created.
There is no operation for regretting line items or submitting TNA scores.
The vendor-list TNA status and the L1 price cannot be asserted from the available read-back fields; only the pricing round response and existence of participants can be checked.
The expected condition that an empty regretted-line list is classified as TNA cannot be verified.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFP + RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited to both rounds; both open for about 20 minutes.
steps: As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked); Schema check: “participants” is present.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked); Schema check: “participants” is present.
